items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Alphonse Peek Good, yeah. He played with the...

ctx.x: And who was the clarinet by that? You said it was Piku then, huh?
Alphonse Peek Good, yeah. He played with the... Was there another one there? No.
Any other clarinet player of them?

items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1962-01-31
items.q: Yeah, Alphonse Peek Good and Javala. Where was it? That was down at Miller Phillips.

ctx.x: And you mentioned some guys gave you a nickname, huh?
Who were they? Yeah, Alphonse Peek Good and Javala. Where was it? That was down at Miller Phillips. I mean at Hunts and Nagels.
And what did they call you? They called me a rat.
